events.title: Adult Pickleball
events.venue: Meerscheidt Recreation Center, 1600 E. Hadley Ave., Las Cruces, NM, 88001, United States
events.description:
Participants must be 18 years of age and are required to check in at the front desk upon arrival. Participation is first come, first served.  
Max participants: 24 
Fees:  

$1 for seniors (60+) 
$2 for adults (18-59) 

*Sessions are subject to change at any time. Call Meerscheidt Recreation Center at 575-541-2563 for more information.
